name: Slashing - [MMMM]
description: Here is a tip for you to scrawl, please underline it twice: the blood belongs inside the body. When you find a bleed, it is your responsibility to stop it as quickly as possible. Do not rely on magical cura to fix the issue, use pressure and tight bandages. Use of leeches not recommended; you want more blood inside the body, not less.

results.description:
Roll to randomly determine your left or right eye. You've taken a grievous ferimento across this eye. It is não funcional, and if not treated dentro de 12 horas, your vision will be permanently ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save Sense Surgery.
results.name: Sliced Eye

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Large membro Table (Tabela de Membros Maiores)}. The intensity of the blow has sliced seu membro clean off. It lands severed at your feet and is considered ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 22 Save membro Surgery.
results.name: Severed membro

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Small apêndice Table (Tabela de Apêndices Menores)}. The savagery of the blow has severed one of your small appendages. It lands at your feet and is considered ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 22 Save membro Surgery.
results.name: Severed apêndice

results.description:
The attack has hit one of your vital points and opened a large artery. Você está sangramento out. At the end of each Turno, take one level of &Reference[Exhaustion]{Exhaustion}.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 16]] check staunches sangramento. On a failed save you do not take a level of Exhaustion at the end of your next Turno. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: Exsanguinating

results.description:
You see blood pour from your ferimento and you feel a bit light headed. At the end of each Turno you take dano to your maximum hit points scaled to the dano that caused the lesão persistente: 1-10 dano ([[1d4]]), 11-20 dano ([[1d6]]), 21-30 dano ([[1d8]]), 31-40 dano ([[1d10]]), >40 dano ([[1d12]]).

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 11]] check staunches the sangramento. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: Hemorrhaging

results.description:
You see blood trickling from your ferimento. It's not a lot, but it adds up. At the end of each Turno you take dano to your maximum hit points scaled to the dano that caused the lesão persistente: 1-10 dano ([[1d2]]), 11-20 dano ([[1d4]]), 21-30 dano ([[1d6]]), 31-40 dano ([[1d8]]), >40 dano ([[1d10]]).

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 10]] check staunches the sangramento. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: sangramento

results.description:
Your ferimento looks angry near its edges and stubbornly refuses to heal. You cannot heal hit points through nonmagical means (such as short or long rests).

Tratamento - Once per long rest you may make a [[/skill medicine 18]] check to heal this injury.
results.name: Festering ferimento

results.description:
You've taken a long, painful slash to one of your legs. Your speed is reduced by 10 feet. This injury lasts [[1d8]] dias.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d6]] dias.
results.name: Leg Laceration

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. Você está left with a thin, sinuous cicatriz on this area of your body.
results.name: Sinuous cicatriz

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. Você está left with a thick, raised cicatriz on this area of your body.
results.name: Hypertrophic cicatriz

results.description:
You see blood trickling from your ferimento. It must be a nicked vein because it's difficult to staunch. At the end of each Turno you take dano to your maximum hit points scaled to the dano that caused the lesão persistente: 1-10 dano ([[1d2]]), 11-20 dano ([[1d4]]), 21-30 dano ([[1d6]]), 31-40 dano ([[1d8]]), >40 dano ([[1d10]]).

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 14]] check staunches the sangramento. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: Stubborn sangramento

results.description:
With every beat of your heart you can feel your lifeblood spilling out. At the end of each Turno you take dano to your maximum hit points scaled to the dano that caused the lesão persistente: 1-10 dano ([[1d4]]), 11-20 dano ([[1d6]]), 21-30 dano ([[1d8]]), 31-40 dano ([[1d10]]), >40 dano ([[1d12]]).

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check staunches the sangramento. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: Stubborn Hemorrhaging

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. Você está left with a cicatriz that look particularly well placed on you. When this cicatriz is visible Você tem a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks. If you collect multiple Aesthetic Scars, this bonus does not stack.
results.name: Aesthetic cicatriz

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Small apêndice Table (Tabela de Apêndices Menores)}. The savage slash has cloven seu apêndice from you, flinging it into the distance. It lands 15 feet away in a random direction and is considered ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 22 Save membro Surgery.
results.name: Traumatic Amputation

results.description:
You feel the cut rake across the back of your leg, and you stumble, crying out in pain. Your speed is reduced by 10 feet.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save membro Surgery.
results.name: Hamstrung
